site.name: DepthGlow
site.tagline: Cinematic AI sites that glow. Copy a prompt, paste it into your AI, launch a site that doesn't look AI-made.

templates.title: Aurora Hero
templates.blurb: Full-viewport hero with a slow-shifting aurora gradient and floating light blooms.
templates.prompt: Build a single self-contained HTML file: a full-viewport hero section with a living aurora gradient background. Layer 3 radial-gradient "light blooms" that drift slowly on independent 18–26s CSS keyframe loops. Keep the aurora on a fixed canvas-free div using conic-gradient + blur(80px) so it stays cheap. Center a headline in a geometric sans (font-feature "ss01"), a one-line subtitle in muted grey, and two pill CTAs (primary solid, secondary ghost). Add a subtle grain overlay via an inline SVG feTurbulence at 4% opacity. Animate the headline in on load with a 0.6s blur-up + translateY. No external JS. Pure HTML/CSS, dark background #0a0a0f, text near-white. Ensure it is responsive and text stays readable at 360px width.

templates.title: Glass SaaS
templates.blurb: Glassmorphism SaaS landing with a feature grid that lifts on hover.
templates.prompt: Build a single self-contained HTML file: a dark SaaS landing page using glassmorphism. Background is a deep navy (#0b1020) with two big blurred color blobs (blue + violet) drifting behind the content. Top nav bar is a floating glass pill (backdrop-filter blur, 1px white/10 border, radius 999px) with logo, 4 links, and a small CTA. Hero: centered headline, subtitle, one primary CTA, and a "trusted by" row of 5 greyed logo placeholders. Below, a 3-column feature grid where each card is glass (rgba white/5, blur, radius 20px) that lifts 6px with a brightened border on hover (0.3s ease). Add a stats strip. Pure HTML/CSS only, no external JS. Responsive: grid collapses to 1 column under 720px.

templates.title: Kinetic Type
templates.blurb: Oversized editorial type that slides, masks and reveals on load.
templates.prompt: Build a single self-contained HTML file: a bold creative/agency page centered on kinetic typography. Use an extremely oversized display headline (clamp from 3rem to 9vw) in a heavy grotesque, set in ALL CAPS with tight negative letter-spacing. Animate each line to slide up from a clipping mask on load, staggered 90ms apart. Behind the type, a thin outlined (stroke-only) duplicate of the same words drifts horizontally on a slow infinite marquee for depth. Add a small top bar with a logo and a single CTA, and a bottom row of 3 project cards (image-placeholder gradient blocks) that scale slightly on hover. Pure HTML/CSS, no external JS. Keep it high-contrast (near-white type on #0a0a0f) and fully responsive.

templates.title: Editorial Portfolio
templates.blurb: Magazine-style portfolio index with an animated work list.
templates.prompt: Build a single self-contained HTML file: an editorial portfolio index for a designer. Light, paper-like background (#f4f2ee) with near-black text for a print feel. A top masthead with the designer's name and a one-line role. Then a "Selected Work" list of 6 rows; each row shows an index number, a large project title, a small year, and a category tag. On hover, a row's title nudges right, the number fades, and a colored preview swatch slides in from the right edge. Stagger a reveal of the rows on load (translateY + opacity). Add a short about paragraph and a footer with contact links. Pure HTML/CSS only. Serif or high-contrast grotesque for titles. Responsive: rows stack cleanly on mobile.

templates.title: Voxel Frontier
templates.blurb: Blocky voxel terrain hero - floating island, drifting clouds, retro-game energy.
templates.prompt: Build a single self-contained HTML file: a full-viewport hero scene of a blocky voxel landscape inspired by sandbox games, using ONLY CSS 3D transforms and HTML divs (no images, no WebGL). Construct one floating grass island from ~40 cube divs (each cube = 6 faces via transform-style:preserve-3d, grass-green top face, dirt-brown sides), tilted 55deg toward the viewer like an orthographic game camera. Add 3 smaller floating islands at different depths, 4 rounded-rect white clouds drifting on independent 30s linear loops, and a sky that gradients from noon blue to sunset orange near the horizon. A single tiny blocky tree (trunk + 3 green cubes) sits on the main island. Overlay: uppercase letterspaced tag, bold headline "Build your world", muted subtitle, two pill CTAs. Keep every animation under 8% CPU: transform/opacity only. Dark vignette at edges for focus.

templates.title: Lofi Study Room
templates.blurb: Cozy lofi study-room mood - warm lamp, rain window, soft anime palette.
templates.prompt: Build a single self-contained HTML file: a full-viewport lofi study-room hero in a soft anime aesthetic, pure CSS+HTML (no images, no WebGL). Scene: warm dusk room — a large rain-streaked window on the right with slow sliding droplet divs, a desk lamp casting a peach radial glow, a steaming mug (3 rising semi-transparent steam divs on 4s loops), a silhouette of a girl with shoulder-length hair sitting at the desk drawn as ONE smooth SVG path filled #1e1b2e (no facial features — silhouette only, this is the 2D-smoothing style: everything rounded, nothing sharp), a floating playlist card UI in the corner, potted plant with 2 leaves that sway 3deg on 6s loops. Palette: cream #fef3c7, peach #fdba74, lavender #c4b5fd, deep ink #1e1b2e. Add TV-scanline overlay at 3% opacity and gentle 0.5% zoom-breath on the whole scene (10s loop). Overlay copy: tag "Lofi x Anime", headline "Study mode: ON", muted subtitle, one pill CTA. All animations transform/opacity only.
